_comment: Drop the contents of mcpServers below into your Claude Desktop config file:
_notes: 1. Replace D:/metacode with the absolute path to your project root.
2. Use the FULL path to your venv's python (Claude Desktop launches subprocesses with a stripped PATH).
3. Restart Claude Desktop fully after saving (Cmd+Q on macOS, Quit from tray on Windows).
4. After restart, click the hammer icon in the chat — you should see ~12 metaoptics tools.
